profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Greenway Health
profile.summary:
Greenway Health benefits from over a decade of software engineering expertise, with a focus on designing and developing robust cloud messaging systems and full-stack applications for the healthcare sector. As a Principal Software Engineer, the role includes leading teams in agile environments, mentoring developers, and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable and secure solutions.  

Previous contributions include architecting a transactional system that processes millions of records monthly and integrating EHR platforms with messaging systems using advanced technologies like HL7, RabbitMQ, and RESTful APIs. Dedicated to fostering innovation, the mission is to create efficient, high-quality applications that enhance patient communication and healthcare delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Architect and develop a cloud messaging transactional system that processes 4 million records per month for over 1000 Greenway costumers — using C#, Microsoft SQL, .Net, LLBLGen, WCF, Web API, RabbitMQ, Angular 2, Visual Cron Jobs, Twilio, and Mandrill.
•	Full-stack developer for a patient portal web app using Angular 2 front-end; ASP.NET MVC, C#; Microsoft SQL, and Entity Framework.
•	Design and develop an integration of two EHR with a messaging system using HL7, Mirth, WCF, RESTful APIs, Window services, C#, SQL Server, and Visual Cron Jobs
•	Lead a team in an agile Scrum / Kanban environment; mentor Mid-level and Junior developers.
•	Work with BA’s and PM to create FDD’s and TDD’s, develop RESTful APIs, create DB schemas, reusable UI components, unit testing, automated tests for QA.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
●	Full-stack developer of a communication and marketing engine that delivers information to patients and their authorized contacts. This application was built using technologies such as. Net Framework 4.0, ASP.NET MVC, Microsoft WCF, SQL Server 2008 R2, The Microsoft Enterprise Library,  LLBLGen, and C#.
●	Supervised code reviews and ensured all solutions met architectural specifications.

positions.title: Programmer Consultant
positions.description:
●	Served as a full stack developer for a portal web app using ASP.NET MVC app, C# back-end, SQL Server data storage, and IIS.
●	Researched and implemented new technologies as features and enhancements

positions.title: Java and Ruby on Rails Developer (Intern)
positions.description:
• Restructured a mid-level Java server, enhancing performance and reliability of web services.  
• Implemented a new database schema using PostgreSQL, improving data management efficiency.  
• Utilized HTTP protocol and XML for seamless data communication, contributing to project success.

positions.title: Developer IPhone Platform (Intern)
positions.description:
• Collaborated with mentors Dr. Jay Ligatti and Dr. Larry Hall on research in Automatic Trail Mapping.  
• Developed innovative solutions for Location-Based Services without relying on satellite technology.  
• Enhanced the accuracy of trail mapping, contributing to advancements in mobile application development.
